title: A Fleeting Spice to the Tonic

text_block_list.text:
Waking up in my room on my day off—
I noticed an envelope waiting in my
mailbox.

Opening the seal, I read the letter.
Inside, written in elegant calligraphy,
were the following words:

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Three are the Goddesses; in introduction,
break,
and rapid climax lies the tale;
in triad resonates the harmony."

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Letter
text_block_list.text:
"In accordance with these principles,
I have prepared three beacons.
Behold the fleeting instant at journey's
end."

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Letter
text_block_list.text:
"The first beacon:
a steel casket swift as the messenger of
the gods.
Beneath the bridge of its passing,
before the gate of gravel, I shall await."

Judging by the dramatic phrasing,
it had to be from Tanino Gimlet...

Pondering it,
a thought struck me. She did say before
that she would lay down guideposts for me.
If I took her literally—
choice_data_list: (Does she mean I should visit thre...

text_block_list.text:
...Standing around thinking wasn't getting
me anywhere.
I decided to head outside for now.

A "swift steel casket" means a train.
"Beneath the bridge of its passing" and
"gate of gravel" must mean a viaduct.
Following that hunch—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—It appears the dispatch reached thee
true.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Do not fluster. Haste begets folly.
More importantly... look above.
(ROOOOOOOAAAR—!!!!)

With a thunderous roar,
a train rushed by overhead.
I was completely engulfed by the deafening
rumble and fierce vibrations—!

It was over in the blink of an eye,
but the sound and shock lingered in my
body.
After standing in a daze for a moment,
I turned my eyes back—and...

Tanino Gimlet had vanished into thin
air...!
In her place,
a single letter lay on the ground.

text_block_list.name: Letter
text_block_list.text:
"The second beacon:
the domain where life and death intertwine
in eternal cycle.
In the realm governed by the goddess of flora,
upon the plain where the zephyr whispers,
I shall await."

Still cryptic as ever—
but could "the realm governed by the goddess
of flora" mean a flower garden...?

Come to think of it,
the train from earlier was headed toward a
flower park.
It might be worth heading there next.
And when I arrived—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Splendidly hast thou answered the zephyr's
invitation.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Heh. It is yet too early for revelry.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Gaze upon the distance.
Beckoned by the tranquil west wind,
the petals scatter.

Following Tanino Gimlet's gaze,
a warm gust blew past,
sending a flurry of flower petals swirling
into the sky—!

In a single instant,
the scenery before me burst into vibrant
color.
Immersed in the breathtaking afterglow of
the sight, I turned back—and...

Just like before,
Tanino Gimlet had vanished in a flash,
leaving another letter behind on the
ground.

text_block_list.name: Letter
text_block_list.text:
"The final beacon:
the forbidden spire that wrought division.
At its pinnacle, overlooking all creation,
I shall await."

A spire must mean the observation tower that
overlooks the city.
It's quite a distance,
but since I've come this far—
I'll see this through to the end!

As I transferred between trains,
the sun gradually dipped below the
horizon—

By the time I reached the tower,
night had fallen.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Thou hast done well to ascend to the pinnacle
of Babel.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Heh.
Expose not thy guard so carelessly,
lest thou be swallowed by chaos.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Rather—gaze upon it. The final vista.
The wolf overtaketh the moon.

Looking down upon the city just as Tanino
Gimlet did—in that exact moment.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Heheh, hahaha! Ahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: AHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!!!!!!

All at once, the city lights switched on,
illuminating the panorama below in a single
breath—!

The entire city sparkled with dazzling
brilliance.
Like a night sky painted with constellations,
I couldn't tear my eyes away.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Didst thou witness it?!
The instantaneous flash!!
The moment where end and beginning
converge!!!
The supreme, the ultimate spice!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
This is precisely what I sought!!
The vista my soul thirsted for!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh... thou too hast been captivated.
...A felicitous fortune.
choice_data_list: Did you want to show me this view?
Did you want to show me this view?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: An affirmation, yet also a denial.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Recall the entire journey.
What didst thou experience?
What didst thou partake in?
What was etched most vividly upon thy
soul?

Prompted by her question,
I reflected back.
Everything I had seen today. That was—
The train rushing past in a single second.
The petals scattering in a fleeting gust.

The city bursting into light in a split
second.
I see—when I think about it,
they all shared one common thread.
choice_data_list: They all happened in a single, fle...
They all happened in a single, fle...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...The optimal deduction.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
That which scatters, shines,
and is born within a fleeting instant.
That which sears itself intensely into the
soul, leaving an eternal resonance.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—That is precisely what I desire.
I act to attain that apex. Hence, I run.

I felt like I finally understood.
What she sought—was likely the "moment."
The brief,
ephemeral spark that burns itself so intensely
into the heart.

Her obsession with both "speed" and
"power"
made total sense when viewed as a pursuit
of that one vivid instant.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh...
it seems the beacons served their purpose.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Thou art the one who grasped the answer.
Direct thy gratitude toward thine own
self.

We stayed there for a while,
taking in the night view together.
Tanino Gimlet looked more satisfied than
ever before.
